records.title: perf(xtask): use built binary instead of cargo run for dogfood gate evaluation
records.release_claim: gate-adoption dogfood runs the exact refreshed candidate binary without per-scenario Cargo invocation
records.reason: This completes the proof-performance group started by #2176 and avoids stale or repeatedly relinked binaries in release qualification.
records.non_claim: Faster dogfood execution does not change gate decisions.
